articles.title: A Giant Storm Soaks New York and New Jersey
articles.summary: A huge storm called a nor'easter flooded streets in New Jersey and New York on Saturday. More than 100,000 homes lost power, and over 2,400 flights were delayed. The full moon made the flooding even worse.

articles.title: Trump Cancels $1 Billion in Spending — Without Asking Congress First
articles.summary: President Trump is canceling nearly $1 billion in money Congress already approved. It pays for refugee help and school programs for migrant kids. A Republican senator says that's illegal.

articles.title: 600,000 People Pack Paris Streets to See Pope Leo!
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV rode his popemobile down the Champs-Élysées in Paris, and more than 600,000 people signed up to see him. He came to lead a huge outdoor mass at Place de la Concorde, right in the heart of the city.
